ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the legend on the left side of the figure indicates that the circle with diagonal lines represents “soil,” the grid-like circle represents “biomass,” the blank circle represents “litter,” and the arrows represent “material nutrient flow.” On the right side there are schematic diagrams of three natural zones at different latitudes, ①②③, and in each schematic diagram there are arrows connecting these types of circles, with different arrow thicknesses, indicating different sizes of material nutrient flow. Then reason: the question asks what the integrity of the geographical environment is manifested as occurring among geographical elements. The soil, biomass, and litter in the figure can be understood as natural geographical elements or components of an ecosystem, and the arrows show that nutrient and other material transfers continuously occur among these elements; in an ecosystem, material flow is usually accompanied by energy flow. Therefore, the integrity of the geographical environment is manifested as the exchange of matter and energy occurring among geographical elements.

method.method_draft: 先读图例和图形：图例标出三个生态系统组成部分为“土壤”“生物量”“枯枝落叶”，箭头表示“物质养分流”；三个纬度示意图中这些圆圈之间都有箭头相互连接。再读题干：题干说明圆圈大小表示储存养分多少、箭头粗细表示物质养分流大小，并问地理环境整体性体现为地理要素间进行着什么。把图中土壤、生物量、枯枝落叶理解为自然地理要素，箭头所示的养分流说明要素之间不断进行物质传递；结合生态系统中物质流动通常伴随能量流动，可得答案为地理要素间进行着“物质和能量的交换”。
